_comment: Single declared entry_kind vocabulary (AC INF-400c-5). Both the route-knowledge classifier (templates/skills/route-knowledge/SKILL.md taxonomy table) and the harvester (scripts/knowledge/harvest_learnings.py _KNOWN_ENTRY_KINDS) must reconcile to exactly this member set. destination_pattern is advisory routing metadata used by scripts/knowledge/emit_knowledge.py to suggest candidates on rejection; a null value means the destination is caller-determined and has no fixed path pattern.

adr.description: A recorded architecture decision and its rationale.

agent-frontmatter.description: Machine-readable configuration of an agent role.

architecture-doc.description: A description of system components and their relationships.

claude-md.description: Project-wide operating instructions for the coding assistant.

claude-md-inline.description: A concise instruction maintained directly in the project guidance.

claude-md-toc.description: A linked instruction document indexed from the project guidance.

code-comment.description: An explanation maintained next to the implementation it describes.

explanation.description: An explanation of project concepts and their rationale.

explanation-doc.description: An explanatory document about a project concept.

glossary.description: An authored definition of project terminology.

how-to.description: A task-oriented procedure for completing a specific operation.

memory-project.description: Persistent context about the project and its current work.

memory-reference.description: A persistent pointer to information used in future work.

memory-user.description: A persistent user preference or correction for future assistance.

per-agent-memory.description: Persistent guidance specific to one agent role.

per-folder-readme.description: Local guidance describing a directory and its contents.

reference.description: A lookup-oriented record of authoritative project details.

reference-doc.description: A reference document for looking up project facts.

retrospective.description: Recorded lessons from completed project work.

skill-context.description: Reusable knowledge needed by a particular skill.

skills-config.description: Project-specific configuration consumed by installed skills.

ticket-body.description: Implementation context maintained with its tracked work item.
